request.style: English, female solo with atmospheric choir, Celtic harp, fiddle, bodhran, flute, soft piano, haunting and solemn mood, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A great eagle with great wings
Came to Lebanon in flight
Took the top of the cedar
Carried it to a trading land
Planted it in fertile soil
Beside abundant water it grew
It became a spreading vine
Roots beneath the eagle's wing

[Chorus]
But the vine turned to another
Stretched its branches for water
Will it thrive in the end
Or wither in the east wind
Torn up by the roots
Stripped of all its fruit

[Verse]
The king of Babylon came
Took the king and officials
Made a covenant with them
Swore an oath to keep them low
But he rebelled against him
Sent envoys to Egypt for help
Broke the covenant he made
Despised the oath he swore

[Chorus]
But the vine turned to another
Stretched its branches for water
Will it thrive in the end
Or wither in the east wind
Torn up by the roots
Stripped of all its fruit

[Bridge]
I will spread my net over him
Catch him in my snare
Bring him to Babylon
Judge his treachery there
All his troops shall fall by sword
Scattered to every wind

[Chorus]
But the vine turned to another
Stretched its branches for water
Will it thrive in the end
Or wither in the east wind
Torn up by the roots
Stripped of all its fruit

[Outro]
I will take a sprig from the cedar
Plant it on the high mountain
It will become a majestic cedar
Birds of every kind will nest
